category_title: Children with SEBN-A exhibiting withdrawn, shy, or inward behavior
scenario_title: Group philosophical dialogue and peer interaction
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle with peers during a philosophical dialogue session and is asked to read a stimulus passage aloud.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our group philosophical dialogue session. Please read the first paragraph of the stimulus passage out loud to the circle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly in the circle, looking at the passage but remaining completely silent.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and start reading whenever you are ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to sit patiently without causing any distractions, but does not speak to her peers.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Would you like to generate a question about the passage for the group instead?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains silent and non-participative in the group work situation, finding it very difficult to speak with her peers despite showing high levels of patience.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are starting our group philosophical dialogue session. Please read the first paragraph of the stimulus passage out loud to the circle.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly in the circle, looking at the passage but remaining completely silent.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and start reading whenever you are ready.

STUDENT: (Continues to sit patiently without causing any distractions, but does not speak to her peers.)

TUTOR: Would you like to generate a question about the passage for the group instead?

STUDENT: (Remains silent and non-participative in the group work situation, finding it very difficult to speak with her peers despite showing high levels of patience.)

task.content: Making verbal contributions during structured philosophical dialogue in CoPI sessions, including reading a stimulus passage and generating questions.
task.learning_goal: Interacting with peers and participating in group work

context.environment: Participants sit in a circle, allowing them to see and be seen by one another... seats are equidistant.
context.social_setting: Whole class for an hour each week... The facilitator remains outside the circle of participants.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: In group work situations where she would normally have remained silent and non-participative
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Remained silent and non-participative, contributing in half or fewer than half of the sessions, while showing high levels of patience and no distraction behaviours.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Found it very difficult to speak with her peers

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to speak with peers
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Found it very difficult to speak with her peers

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Contributing in half or fewer than half of the sessions, showed high levels of patience and no distraction behaviours
